subject: AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
text:
U1173/26 NOTAMR U0724/26
Q)UUWV/QOAXX/IV/BO/A/000/999/5535N03716E999
A)UUUU B)2609010615 C)2612012359 EST
E)AS A RESPONSE MEASURE TO THE DECISION OF THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF THE REPUBLIC OF CYPRUS STIPULATING THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED,
CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF THE
RUSSIAN FEDERATION AND BY OPERATORS HOLDING AIR OPERATOR
CERTIFICATE (AOC) ISSUED BY THE AUTHORITIES OF THE RUSSIAN
FEDERATION ARE PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR OVERFLYING THE
AIRSPACE OF CYPRUS (REF AIP SUP 001/2024), THE AVIATION AUTHORITIES
OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION HEREBY INFORM THAT ALL AIRCRAFT OWNED,
CHARTERED, OPERATED OR OTHERWISE CONTROLLED BY CITIZENS OF CYPRUS
 AND BY OPERATORS HOLDING AOC ISSUED BY THE AUTHORITIES OF THE
 REPUBLIC OF CYPRUS ARE PROHIBITED FROM ENTERING, EXITING OR
 OVERFLYING THE AIRSPACE OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION EXCEPT FOR
 AIRCRAFT IN AN EMERGENCY, HUMANITARIAN FLIGHTS, AMBULANCE FLIGHTS
 AND IN CASES WHEN A SPECIAL PERMISSION FOR FLIGHT OPERATIONS IS
 GRANTED BY THE FEDERAL AIR TRANSPORT AGENCY OR THE MINISTRY OF
 FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE RUSSIAN FEDERATION AS APPROPRIATE.
